comments.author: Hernan
comments.body: 250mil is the normal going rate; I picked up mine for that much. The rarity of this EQ may make some people try to sell it for higher, but that doesn't necessarily mean they're correct in talking down others about this price. I guess they're trying to get what they can before it appears again in a future Sailor Bottle.

comments.author: H.-Gazi
comments.body:
I've been walking with that armour and it took me just 100m from the Bazaar in Londen a month ago. It seems hard to find a bazaar with such a price, so if you see it then buy it immediately!

This is great for people who are offensive, while having an good defence. Also due the extreme high durability, it is very easy to repair it (drawing "The World" from Silver Tarot card).

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body: The blue, purple and black versions of this armor are UWC-only and can only be obtained from players that purchased/won them in the past. I forget if black is available on Maris, but blue/purple certainly are. They're just a bit rare but it isn't impossible if you're persistent enough, I suppose. Best of luck in your hunt; cheers.

comments.body: Got the black one by scavenging around Seville few years ago, so it's confirmed to exist on Maris in the past.
